zones.label: Ada: Chief of Staff
zones.summary: Ada is your chief of staff: the one agent every other agent reports to, and the one that decides what reaches you.
facts: Keeps your personal knowledge graph and answers "what do I already know about X?" from it.
Reads, labels, and summarizes your email, and drafts replies for you to send.
Owns your personal calendar, so any event that needs your time goes through Ada.
Never sends mail, accepts invitations, or spends money without your approval.

zones.label: Scout: Novelty and Prior-Art Search
zones.summary: Scout searches the literature, patents, and public code and tells you what was and was not found for each claim in your idea.
facts: Reports one of three verdicts: no close match found, partially covered, or already published.
Never says an idea is novel; it lists the sources it searched instead.
Feeds a prior-art summary to Rosa for the significance section of a proposal.
Never reports a citation it has not opened.

zones.label: Marisol: Events and Speakers
zones.summary: Marisol turns a speaker idea into a confirmed seminar with a room, a host, and a reminder trail.
facts: Owns the department's event calendar; Ada owns your personal one.
Re-confirms each speaker a week before the visit.
Passes honoraria, travel, and catering costs to Penny.
Asks before sending the first invitation to any new speaker.

zones.label: Penny: Lab Budgets and Finance
zones.summary: Penny shows what each grant has spent, what remains, and what is about to go wrong, and prepares the paperwork so you only approve it.
facts: Reconciles each account against the university ledger by budget line.
Projects spending to the end of the award, so a line that runs out early is flagged months ahead.
Builds the budget tables and justification that Rosa needs for a proposal.
Never moves money, makes purchases, or enters card details.

zones.label: Rosa: Grant Writing
zones.summary: Rosa finds the funding call, builds the proposal skeleton, and drafts and tightens the text until the point is clear in the first paragraph.
facts: Ranks funding opportunities by fit with your research and lists deadlines and eligibility.
Runs a mock review that lists the weakest points before real reviewers find them.
Tracks the university's sponsored-programs deadline, which comes days before the sponsor's.
Never submits a proposal or invents preliminary results; a human submits.

zones.label: Pixel: Presentations and Web
zones.summary: Pixel makes your work easy to present and easy to find, with clear decks for talks and a web profile that stays as current as your last paper.
facts: Adds alt text, checks color contrast, and recolors figures for color-blind readers.
Edits a staging copy of your web page and asks before anything goes live.
Compares every number and citation on a slide to its source before handing over a deck.
Never puts unpublished results on a public page.

zones.label: Kai: Conferences and Proposals
zones.summary: Kai finds the conferences worth your time, gets strong proposals in on time, and drafts the travel so you can focus on the talk.
facts: Checks sponsor, indexing, and program-committee quality for every venue.
Tracks each submission through review, rebuttal, and camera-ready dates.
Sends cost estimates to Penny and accepted-talk details to Pixel.
Never pays a registration fee, books travel, or submits without your approval.

quiz.question: Which agent decides what reaches you and coordinates all the others?
quiz.explanation: Ada is the chief of staff. Every other agent reports its results to Ada.

quiz.question: Which agent checks whether a research idea has already been published?
quiz.explanation: Scout searches papers, patents, and code and reports the closest prior art for each claim.

quiz.question: Which agent finds, invites, and confirms seminar speakers?
quiz.explanation: Marisol runs the department's event calendar and the speaker pipeline.

quiz.question: Which agent warns you that the equipment line of a grant will run out early?
quiz.explanation: Penny forecasts the burn rate on each budget line and flags overruns.

quiz.question: Which agent runs a mock review and lists the weakest points of a proposal?
quiz.explanation: Rosa plays the skeptical reviewer before the real reviewers see the proposal.

quiz.question: Which agent keeps your university web page current and checks slide numbers against their sources?
quiz.explanation: Pixel builds decks and figures and edits a staging copy of your web page.

quiz.question: Which agent tracks calls for papers and flags predatory venues?
quiz.explanation: Kai vets the sponsor, indexing, and program committee of each conference.
